purpose: Section 30/38: honest disclosure of every open risk this phase surfaced or carried forward, so the next architectural decision (25) is made with full information.

risksNewThisPhase.description: The 12-state detailed taxonomy is not reproducibly applicable by independent reviewers at the required 85% threshold, on either the original 65-case sample (76.7%) or a fresh 22-case holdout under a rubric clarification specifically targeted at the confirmed defect (69.7%, WORSE). Binary credit/no-credit IS reproducible (94.9%/97.0%) - the problem is confined to the detailed label.

INCOMPARABLE vs DISCOVERED_ONLY emerged as the dominant confusion on the holdout, driven by CONMED's blank-literal-excerpt/description-only ground-truth authoring convention interacting with INCOMPARABLE's own underspecified 'override evidence' language. This was not visible in the original 65-case sample and was not addressed by the one permitted redesign (which targeted two DIFFERENT, already-confirmed mechanisms). A genuinely reproducible taxonomy for this corpus may need to resolve THIS ambiguity too - which this phase's single-redesign budget did not have room for.

A smaller, low-volume confusion cluster among SEMANTICALLY_REPRESENTED_UNVERIFIED / PARTIAL_SEMANTIC_REPRESENTATION / SEMANTICALLY_REPRESENTED_VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE / HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED was observed in the original study but was not large or structurally concentrated enough to identify a minimum evidence-backed fix. Left unaddressed.

VERIFIED_SEMANTIC_REPRESENTATION was assigned ZERO times across 195 independent ratings (3 raters x 65 cases) plus 66 more on the holdout - not because the distinction is unimportant, but because Headroom's verification stage currently produces no evidence, reachable by either V2 or a human reviewer, that would ever satisfy this state's honest necessary conditions in any of the 4 frozen datasets. This is a pipeline/data-architecture gap, not a taxonomy defect - flagged for the eventual 'genuine production weaknesses the trustworthy evaluator exposes' work-stream (Section 38), once a trustworthy evaluator exists.

The Agent tool's per-session scratchpad directory is shared across all subagents dispatched in one orchestrating session and is not adjudicator-isolated by default, causing one holdout adjudicator's temp file to be transiently overwritten by another's. Verified post-hoc that no contamination reached final results (zero verbatim matches, independently-diverging reasoning), but this is a real infrastructure gap that should be fixed (unique scratch subdirectories per adjudicator) before this methodology is reused.

V2's deterministic binary disposition disagrees with the (non-certified, but binary-reproducible) adjudicator consensus on 9 of 65 original-sample cases (all V2 under-crediting) and 3 of 22 holdout cases (all V2 over-crediting). Neither direction is confirmed as 'V2 is wrong' given the demonstrated detailed-taxonomy unreliability, but these 12 specific cases (listed in 19) warrant manual legal review before being dismissed, especially the 3 holdout over-credit cases which are the closer analogue to a false-credit risk.

risksCarriedForwardFromWorkstreamA.description: The I_CLAIM_IDENTITY fix (Workstream A) only addresses candidates anchored at a SIBLING sub-item under the SAME parent section. It does not address a candidate anchored at a completely different, non-sibling base section (e.g. '1.06' vs '6.05(b)') that happens to share family/lexical vocabulary. Confirmed via debugging to be a distinct, still-open mechanism. Not fixed this phase (frozen matcher, Section 10).

Definitional candidates within an undifferentiated bare section (e.g. both anchored at bare '1.01' with no enumerated sub-item) are not addressed by I_CLAIM_IDENTITY, which returns NOT_COMPARABLE whenever either side lacks an enumerated sub-item. Still open.

Confirmed (Phase 3F.1.5.2 forensics) root cause of the Article X cluster disagreement: EXERCISE_REMEDIES regex overbreadth. Deliberately NOT fixed in 3F.1.5.2 due to blast-radius/effort-budget reasoning, and untouched by the frozen Workstream A matcher this phase. Still open.

risksResolvedThisPhase.description: Phase 3F.1.5.2's Risk R3 (dominant remaining defect: sibling/sub-provision identity discrimination gap) - RESOLVED by Workstream A's I_CLAIM_IDENTITY dimension, verified at both single-case and at-scale (fwrg-6.06-b-ii) granularity, with 22 new adversarial tests, zero regression.
